verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals documents its own paging capability: alerts route to individuals through escalation policies and on-call schedules, with 'multi-platform notifications' (docs-34/75) and direct user notification (docs-40). The evidence never names the specific channels or shows per-user, per-channel rules, so only a thin slice of the story is supported. missing for 10: explicit documentation of push, SMS, phone-call and email paging channels, per-user per-channel notification rules (delays/ordering), independent or hands-on corroboration.
